concepts.label: Help
concepts.definition: Providing assistance; directional participants are not inferred.

concepts.label: Yes
concepts.definition: An affirmative answer, not an inferred sentence affirmation.

concepts.label: No
concepts.definition: A negative answer; distinct from absence, NOT, NONE and NOTHING.

concepts.label: Love (affection)
concepts.definition: Affection as a lexical concept; not ILY, HUG or the complete sentence I love you.

concepts.label: Hello
concepts.definition: Greeting; no reviewed motion currently supplied.

concepts.label: Thank you
concepts.definition: Expression of gratitude; no reviewed motion currently supplied.

concepts.label: I love you
concepts.definition: Complete English expression; legacy illustration is not a validated ASL sentence.

concepts.label: Water
concepts.definition: Water as a liquid, distinct from the verb to water plants.

concepts.label: Family
concepts.definition: A group of relatives; variant and scope require ASL review.

concepts.label: Remember
concepts.definition: Recall or retain a memory; distinct from directional REMIND.

concepts.label: Please
concepts.definition: Polite request marker, distinct from the verb meaning satisfy.

concepts.label: You
concepts.definition: Second-person addressee; signing location/direction and plural distinctions need review.

concepts.label: I / me
concepts.definition: Speaker reference, distinct from the fingerspelled letter I.

concepts.label: Like (enjoy)
concepts.definition: Enjoy or have a preference for; not resemblance or a filler word.

concepts.label: Like (similar)
concepts.definition: Resemblance or comparison; not enjoyment.

concepts.label: Bank (financial)
concepts.definition: A financial institution; not an edge of a river.
exampleContexts: I deposited money at the bank.

concepts.label: Riverbank
concepts.definition: Land at the edge of a river or stream.
exampleContexts: I sat on the river bank.

concepts.label: Light (illumination)
concepts.definition: Visible illumination or a lamp; not low weight.

concepts.label: Light (low weight)
concepts.definition: Having little weight; not illumination.

concepts.label: Right (direction)
concepts.definition: Rightward direction; not correctness or a legal entitlement.

concepts.label: Right (correct)
concepts.definition: Correct or true; not a direction.

concepts.label: Now
concepts.definition: Current time; keeps the phrase right now distinct from rightward/correct.

concepts.label: Friend
concepts.definition: A person with a friendship relationship; source variant is not approved.

concepts.label: Drink
concepts.definition: Consume a liquid; alcohol, container and manner variants require separate review.

concepts.label: Want
concepts.definition: Desire something; not lack, need, or a negated desire.

concepts.label: Need
concepts.definition: Require something; intensity and modality are not inferred from an isolated clip.

concepts.label: Where
concepts.definition: Ask about a location; question nonmanuals are required.

concepts.label: Who
concepts.definition: Ask about a person; not a relative-clause mapping.

concepts.label: When
concepts.definition: Ask about time; not a conditional or relative clause.

concepts.label: Why
concepts.definition: Ask about a reason; not a complete sentence template.

concepts.label: How
concepts.definition: Ask about manner; not quantity, age, or a complete greeting.

concepts.label: Good
concepts.definition: Positive quality; not GOOD-NIGHT, THANK-YOU or a complete evaluation.

concepts.label: Bad
concepts.definition: Negative quality; not a sentence-level negation substitute.

concepts.label: Happy
concepts.definition: A feeling of happiness; facial expression requires review.

concepts.label: Sad
concepts.definition: A feeling of sadness; facial expression requires review.

concepts.label: Work
concepts.definition: Labor or employment; not function correctly, operate, or an artwork.

concepts.label: School
concepts.definition: A place or institution for education; not a group of fish.

concepts.label: Home
concepts.definition: A residence or home; not a sports home team.

concepts.label: Mother
concepts.definition: A mother or female parent; compound family terms require separate mappings.

concepts.label: Sister
concepts.definition: A female sibling; not a religious title or metaphorical relation.

concepts.label: Name
concepts.definition: A name identifying a person; not the verb appoint, and not a name sign for a person.

concepts.label: Know
concepts.definition: Have knowledge; not know-how or sentence-level negation.

concepts.label: Understand
concepts.definition: Comprehend information; not a complete question or a negative statement.

concepts.label: Learn
concepts.definition: Acquire knowledge; not teach or a reviewed inflected sentence.

concepts.label: Go
concepts.definition: Move away or toward a destination; direction and referents require review.

concepts.label: Come
concepts.definition: Move toward a referent; not an invitation sentence template.

concepts.label: Stop
concepts.definition: Cease an action; not a bus stop or a full imperative sentence.

concepts.label: Sorry
concepts.definition: An expression of apology; not sorrow or a complete polite sentence.

concepts.label: Bathroom
concepts.definition: Room/use-restroom meaning; not a bathroom fixture or BATH+ROOM composition.

concepts.label: Sleep
concepts.definition: Sleep as a state; not SLEEP-IN or an approved sleepy/exhausted mapping.

concepts.label: Tired
concepts.definition: A feeling of fatigue; degree and body expression require review.

concepts.label: Doctor
concepts.definition: A medical practitioner; not an academic degree/title.

concepts.label: Hospital
concepts.definition: A hospital facility; not patient, doctor or an automatic clinic alias.

concepts.label: Hurt
concepts.definition: Physical hurt/pain candidate; location, severity and emotional hurt need separate review.

concepts.label: Hot
concepts.definition: High temperature; not spicy food or attractiveness.

concepts.label: Cold
concepts.definition: Low temperature; not a head cold/illness or an automatic winter mapping.

concepts.label: Coffee
concepts.definition: Coffee beverage; not all drinks or an inferred order/request.

concepts.label: Tea
concepts.definition: Tea beverage; not a drink request or every brewing method.

concepts.label: Milk
concepts.definition: Milk as liquid; not the verb to milk an animal.

concepts.label: Apple
concepts.definition: Apple fruit; not a company or personal name.

concepts.label: Bread
concepts.definition: Bread as food; not a slang term for money.

concepts.label: Fish
concepts.definition: A fish/animal candidate; FISHING as an action is distinct.

concepts.label: Vegetable
concepts.definition: Vegetable as food; exact source lexical variant requires review.

concepts.label: Teacher
concepts.definition: A person who teaches; complete TEACHER is not simply an approved TEACH clip.

concepts.label: Student
concepts.definition: A learner/student; complete person component and compound realization require review.

concepts.label: Read
concepts.definition: Read written text; aspect, repetition and metaphorical senses are not inferred.

concepts.label: Write
concepts.definition: Produce written text; not automatically WRITE-DOWN or SIGN-A-CONTRACT.

concepts.label: Book
concepts.definition: A book as bound reading material; not the verb reserve.

concepts.label: Hearing
concepts.definition: Hearing-person/status candidate; not physical auditory action or a legal hearing.

concepts.label: Again
concepts.definition: Again/repeat; exact movement and sentence scope require review.

concepts.label: Today
concepts.definition: The current day; not an unconditional synonym for NOW.

concepts.label: Tomorrow
concepts.definition: The next day; repetition may change meaning and is not inferred as DAILY.

concepts.label: Yesterday
concepts.definition: The previous day; not general past tense for every verb.

concepts.label: Morning
concepts.definition: Morning time; not a reviewed GOOD-MORNING greeting.

concepts.label: Night
concepts.definition: Night time; not an automatic TONIGHT or GOOD-NIGHT phrase.

concepts.label: Money
concepts.definition: Money/currency candidate; CASH, PAY and deposits remain separate meanings.

concepts.label: Buy
concepts.definition: Purchase something; not shopping by repetition or metaphorical belief.

concepts.label: Ask
concepts.definition: Ask a question; direction and participants require review, not formal REQUEST or PRAY.

concepts.label: Feel
concepts.definition: Internal feeling/sensation; not touch an object or automatic FEEL-LIKE.

concepts.label: Children
concepts.definition: Plural young people/offspring; number, height and plural motion require review.

concepts.label: Man
concepts.definition: An adult male person; not a generic term for all humanity.

concepts.label: Woman
concepts.definition: An adult female person; preserve source variant rather than substitute MOTHER.

concepts.label: Boy
concepts.definition: A boy/young male person; not a generic synonym for MAN.

concepts.label: Girl
concepts.definition: A girl/young female person; not a generic synonym for WOMAN.

concepts.label: Language
concepts.definition: A human language/system of communication; not a validated programming-language mapping.

concepts.label: Sign
concepts.definition: Use a signed language; not a posted notice or signing a contract.

concepts.label: English
concepts.definition: The English language; not every British nationality/geographic sense.

concepts.label: Slow
concepts.definition: Low speed; movement intensity/nonmanual modification is not a grammatical speed control.

concepts.label: Fast
concepts.definition: High speed; not abstaining from food or every immediate/urgent meaning.

concepts.label: Day
concepts.definition: Day period; temporal number, past/future and duration need separate plans.

concepts.label: Week
concepts.definition: A week period; not a reviewed numeric-duration construction.

concepts.label: Month
concepts.definition: A month period; calendar name and numerical duration are not inferred.

concepts.label: Year
concepts.definition: A year period; age, number and calendar agreement need separate review.

concepts.label: Pay
concepts.definition: Pay money; direction/recipient is not inferred, PAY-ATTENTION is distinct.

concepts.label: Car
concepts.definition: A road car/vehicle; not every automobile-operation sentence.

concepts.label: Bus
concepts.definition: A road bus; source lexical vs fingerspelled realization must be identified.

concepts.label: Train
concepts.definition: A rail vehicle; not the verb to teach or train an animal.

concepts.label: Walk
concepts.definition: Travel on foot; manner, classifier use and direction need separate review.

concepts.label: Sit
concepts.definition: Be seated/sit; not every CHAIR meaning or an imperative phrase.

concepts.label: Wait
concepts.definition: Wait; waiting a long time, anxiety and intensity are not inferred.

concepts.label: Finish
concepts.definition: An action already done/completed; not continue until completion or every English finish sense.

concepts.label: Big
concepts.definition: Large size; intensity, spatial shape and degree need separate review.

concepts.label: Small
concepts.definition: Small size; not an unconditional LITTLE quantity or LOW amount mapping.

concepts.label: Important
concepts.definition: Importance; not price/value, emergencies or a generic urgency marker.

concepts.label: Answer
concepts.definition: Respond/answer; direction, participants and a complete reply need review.

concepts.label: Tell
concepts.definition: Tell information; direction/participants are not inferred from an isolated clip.

concepts.label: Think
concepts.definition: Think/mental consideration; not all English belief, opinion or remember meanings.

concepts.label: See
concepts.definition: See visually; not every visit, comprehend or metaphorical English sense.

concepts.label: Listen
concepts.definition: Attend/listen to sound; not necessarily physical hearing ability or a legal hearing.

concepts.label: Hungry
concepts.definition: Hungry for food; degree and facial expression require review.

concepts.label: Thirsty
concepts.definition: Need/desire for liquid from thirst; not slang or a complete drink request.

concepts.label: Toilet (fixture)
concepts.definition: A plumbing toilet fixture, distinct from the room or use-restroom meaning.

concepts.label: Doctor (academic title)
concepts.definition: A doctoral degree/title holder; distinct from the medical practitioner sense.

concepts.label: Cold (cold illness)
concepts.definition: A common cold illness; not low temperature.

concepts.label: Hot (spicy flavor)
concepts.definition: Spicy/pungent food; not high physical temperature.

concepts.label: Book (reserve booking)
concepts.definition: Reserve a place or service; not a bound reading object.

concepts.label: Train (training action)
concepts.definition: Teach or train someone; not a rail vehicle.

concepts.label: Hearing (auditory sense)
concepts.definition: Physical auditory perception/ability; distinct from hearing-person status.

concepts.label: Hearing (legal session)
concepts.definition: A legal or official hearing; not auditory perception or a hearing person.

concepts.label: Sign (posted notice)
concepts.definition: A posted notice/symbol; not signed-language use.

concepts.label: Sign (signature action)
concepts.definition: Put a signature on a document; not signed-language use.

concepts.label: Fast (food abstinence)
concepts.definition: Abstain from food; not high speed.

concepts.label: Nurse
concepts.definition: A nursing professional; not the verb breastfeed or a complete request.

concepts.label: Medicine
concepts.definition: Medication; not all drugs, treatment, or medical advice.

concepts.label: Headache
concepts.definition: Pain in the head; exact location and severity require review.

concepts.label: Health
concepts.definition: Physical health or wellbeing; not a diagnosis or promise of care.

concepts.label: Blood
concepts.definition: Blood as a body fluid; not family ancestry or metaphorical meanings.

concepts.label: Body
concepts.definition: A human physical body; not an organization or body of text.

concepts.label: Breathe
concepts.definition: Breathe or respire; intensity and clinical meanings are not inferred.

concepts.label: Cough
concepts.definition: Coughing as an action; not a diagnosis.

concepts.label: Therapy
concepts.definition: Therapeutic treatment; type and source variant require human review.

concepts.label: Surgery
concepts.definition: A surgical procedure; not an office or a guaranteed operation.

concepts.label: Vomit
concepts.definition: Expel stomach contents; nonmanual features need review.
exampleContexts: I feel like I may vomit.

concepts.label: Rest
concepts.definition: Rest or take a break; not the remainder of a quantity.

concepts.label: Clean
concepts.definition: Clean or remove dirt; not an unrelated metaphorical meaning.

concepts.label: Dirty
concepts.definition: Dirty or unclean; not obscene language or metaphorical behavior.

concepts.label: Soap
concepts.definition: Soap used for washing; not a soap opera.

concepts.label: Shower
concepts.definition: A shower for washing; not rain or a celebration.

concepts.label: Bed
concepts.definition: A bed for sleeping; not a garden bed or river bed.

concepts.label: Bedroom
concepts.definition: A room used for sleeping; not a reviewed compound assembled from separate clips.

concepts.label: Kitchen
concepts.definition: A room for preparing food.

concepts.label: Chair
concepts.definition: A chair for sitting; not chairing a committee.

concepts.label: Door
concepts.definition: A door opening into a space; not opportunity or a named product.

concepts.label: Window
concepts.definition: A window in a building; not a software window.

concepts.label: Clothes
concepts.definition: Clothing or garments; source lexical scope requires review.

concepts.label: Shirt
concepts.definition: A shirt garment; not all clothes.

concepts.label: Shoes
concepts.definition: Shoes or footwear; exact singular/plural realization requires review.

concepts.label: Banana
concepts.definition: A banana fruit.

concepts.label: Cheese
concepts.definition: Cheese as food; not a request to smile for a photograph.

concepts.label: Egg
concepts.definition: An egg as food; not a metaphorical egg.

concepts.label: Fruit
concepts.definition: Fruit as food; not metaphorical results.

concepts.label: Orange
concepts.definition: The orange fruit; color and other senses require clarification.

concepts.label: Potato
concepts.definition: A potato as food.

concepts.label: Tomato
concepts.definition: A tomato as food.

concepts.label: Soup
concepts.definition: Soup as food; not a generic meal request.

concepts.label: Sandwich
concepts.definition: A sandwich as food; not the verb squeeze between objects.

concepts.label: Salt
concepts.definition: Salt as a food seasoning; not the sea or a chemistry-specific claim.

concepts.label: Cook
concepts.definition: Prepare food by cooking; not a person who is a cook.

concepts.label: Delicious
concepts.definition: Food tasting pleasant; intensity and facial expression require review.

concepts.label: Full
concepts.definition: Satiated after eating; container capacity and filled spaces remain different senses.

concepts.label: Restaurant
concepts.definition: A restaurant; not an automatically translated request for a table.

concepts.label: Husband
concepts.definition: A husband or male spouse; relationship and regional variant require review.

concepts.label: Wife
concepts.definition: A wife or female spouse; relationship and regional variant require review.

concepts.label: Uncle
concepts.definition: An uncle as a family relationship; not a personal name.

concepts.label: Cousin
concepts.definition: A cousin as a family relationship; gendered variants require review.

concepts.label: Nephew
concepts.definition: A nephew as a family relationship.

concepts.label: Niece
concepts.definition: A niece as a family relationship.

concepts.label: Grandmother
concepts.definition: A grandmother or female grandparent; exact family variant requires review.

concepts.label: Grandfather
concepts.definition: A grandfather or male grandparent; exact family variant requires review.

concepts.label: Parents
concepts.definition: Parents as a family relationship; number and family composition require review.

concepts.label: Person
concepts.definition: A human person; not the grammatical person of a verb.

concepts.label: Adult
concepts.definition: A grown person; not an unrelated media classification.

concepts.label: Interpreter
concepts.definition: A person interpreting between languages; not a software interpreter.

concepts.label: Translate
concepts.definition: Translate between languages; not movement or an automatic sentence translation promise.

concepts.label: Talk
concepts.definition: Talk or converse; exact modality, direction and discourse role require review.

concepts.label: Show
concepts.definition: Show something to another person; not a performance or television show.

concepts.label: Sentence
concepts.definition: A linguistic sentence; not a criminal punishment.

concepts.label: Word
concepts.definition: A word in a language; not a promise or named software product.

concepts.label: Example
concepts.definition: An illustrative example; not automatically a complete explanatory phrase.

concepts.label: Class
concepts.definition: An instructional class; not social class, quality, or programming.

concepts.label: Lesson
concepts.definition: A unit of teaching; not a punitive metaphor.

concepts.label: Homework
concepts.definition: Schoolwork assigned to do outside class.

concepts.label: Library
concepts.definition: A library for reading and borrowing; not a software library.

concepts.label: Computer
concepts.definition: A computer device; not a named product.

concepts.label: Paper
concepts.definition: Paper material; not automatically a newspaper, essay or examination.

concepts.label: Pencil
concepts.definition: A pencil writing tool; not a scheduling verb.

concepts.label: Test
concepts.definition: A test or assessment; medical tests and experimentation need separate context review.

concepts.label: Afternoon
concepts.definition: The period after noon; not a full good-afternoon greeting.

concepts.label: Hour
concepts.definition: An hour of duration; number incorporation requires separate review.

concepts.label: Minute
concepts.definition: A minute of duration; smallness or meeting minutes are separate senses.

concepts.label: Monday
concepts.definition: Monday as a weekday; recurrence and tense are not inferred.

concepts.label: Wednesday
concepts.definition: Wednesday as a weekday; recurrence and tense are not inferred.

concepts.label: Thursday
concepts.definition: Thursday as a weekday; recurrence and tense are not inferred.

concepts.label: Friday
concepts.definition: Friday as a weekday; recurrence and tense are not inferred.

concepts.label: Saturday
concepts.definition: Saturday as a weekday; recurrence and tense are not inferred.

concepts.label: Later
concepts.definition: At a later time; not a full farewell phrase.

concepts.label: Late
concepts.definition: Later than expected; not deceased or recent.

concepts.label: Angry
concepts.definition: Feeling anger; intensity and nonmanual features require review.

concepts.label: Scared
concepts.definition: Feeling fear; source handshape and facial features require review.

concepts.label: Worry
concepts.definition: Worry or feel concern; not an unrelated reassurance sentence.

concepts.label: Bored
concepts.definition: Feeling bored; not drilling a hole.

concepts.label: Lonely
concepts.definition: Feeling lonely; being physically alone is not assumed equivalent.

concepts.label: Comfortable
concepts.definition: Feeling comfortable; confident or financially secure meanings are not inferred.

concepts.label: Relax
concepts.definition: Relax or release tension; exact realization and nonmanuals require review.

concepts.label: Stress
concepts.definition: Psychological stress; mechanical pressure and word emphasis are separate senses.

concepts.label: Smile
concepts.definition: A smile as an action; not grammatical nonmanuals for arbitrary ASL sentences.

concepts.label: Cry
concepts.definition: Cry with tears; not call out or shout.
exampleContexts: I cry when I am sad.

concepts.label: Laugh
concepts.definition: Laugh as an action; expression and source timing require review.

concepts.label: Ready
concepts.definition: Being prepared or ready; not money or a complete question.

concepts.label: Easy
concepts.definition: Low difficulty; not a command to slow down.

concepts.label: Hard
concepts.definition: High difficulty; solid texture and physical force are separate senses.

concepts.label: Different
concepts.definition: Different or not the same; source variant and comparison scope require review.

concepts.label: Old
concepts.definition: Old in age; person versus object realization requires review.

concepts.label: Young
concepts.definition: Young in age; not a proper name.
